sources: RIDB per-site catalog for facility 234551 (ridb.recreation.gov/api/v1/facilities/234551/campsites, with coordinates)
Esri World_Imagery around the site points

values.note: 21 gravel drive-in sites (a 22nd, site 003, is a management site), about half pull-through. recreation.gov gives no maximum vehicle length (0 on every site); its driveway lengths run 25-130 ft, most 45 ft or more (12 and 13 are 30 and 25 ft).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/dumont-lake-campground ('The campground is made up of 21 sites which are combination of pull-through and back-in sites') + RIDB catalog for 234551 (21 STANDARD NONELECTRIC + 003 MANAGEMENT; Driveway Entry 10 Pull-Through; Driveway Length 25-130; Max Vehicle Length 0), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: RIDB catalog for 234551 (every site STANDARD NONELECTRIC, no hookup attributes) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/dumont-lake-campground ('Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/dumont-lake-campground ('Vault Toilet (3)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Late June to October 1 (FS); opening is weather dependent and may be late after heavy snow. recreation.gov's 2026 first-come season ran Sept 14 - Oct 17.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/dumont-lake-campground ('Seasons of Use: Late June - October 1'; 'Open seasonally, (late June/Early July) weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234551/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-09-14 to 2026-10-17), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 15 sites reservable on recreation.gov and 6 first-come (FS). Reservations run June 30 - Sept 13 (2026, the same dates posted for 2027); after that the campground is first-come. 14 days in a 30-day period. Walk-ups pay at the kiosk by exact cash or check.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/dumont-lake-campground ('15 are reservable through recreation.gov and 6 sites are first-come, first-served basis'; 'Camping limit is 14 days in a 30 day period'; 'Exact cash or check only') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234551 (maxConsecutiveStay 14) and /rates (Peak Season 2026-06-30 to 2026-09-13, 2027-06-30 to 2027-09-13), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $26 a site (2026 and 2027). The lakeside day-use picnic area charges $5/vehicle/day, separate from the campsite fee.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234551/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26; 2026 walk-in 26) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/dumont-lake-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night'; 'Day-use picnic area at the lake has a $5/vehicle/day fee'), read 2026-10-28

note: ~9,400 ft, about a mile up FR 315 off US-40 on Rabbit Ears Pass. The campground sits back across the alpine meadow from 50-acre Dumont Lake; the lake itself is at the separate day-use picnic area (electric motors or hand-propelled boats only). --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov 234551 + RIDB catalog: confirmed no hookups, vault toilets, no potable water, reservable with first-come sites, $26 (2026/2027), phone 970-870-2299 (rec.gov facility phone = Hahns Peak/Bears Ears RD). Changed sites 22 -> 21 (FS; 003 is a management site); season: removed calendar-derived 'closes 09-13' (that is the end of reservations) for the FS 'late June - October 1'; added booking.season 06-30..09-13, 14-night max. No maximum vehicle length published (catalog 0; driveways 25-130 ft). Pin 87 m from the site centroid. Note trimmed.
flags: Waterfront (stored lakeview): the RIDB site points sit on an open meadow ~250-300 m east of Dumont Lake's east shore/dam, with no tree screen between; recreation.gov says 'most have clear views of the alpine meadow around the lake' and 'Dumont Lake is located at the picnic area, which a short walk away'. Consistent with lakeview; no contrary claim.

FS page header reads 'Site Closed' (2026-10-28); the FS season is late June - October 1 and recreation.gov's first-come season ended Oct 17, so this is the ordinary end-of-season closing, not recorded as a status.
The FS page gives only the forest supervisor's office number (307) 745-2300; the stored 970-870-2299 is recreation.gov's facility phone for the Hahns Peak/Bears Ears Ranger District (kept).
